notes: News 10.11. official performance statement (Rockstar Newswire 'Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now'); 2nd sources IGN, GamesRadar+, VideoCardz, Wccftech. Dup check: preload post (10.11.) covered preload times/212 GB/Festival, Xbox One cloud post (11.11.) covered cloud + Series S settings -> not repeated here. Scheduled Sat 14.11. 12:00.

tips.title: NO 60 FPS YET
tips.body:
Rockstar's post names one target: 30 FPS.
A 60 FPS mode was not announced.

tips.title: FULL DENSITY
tips.body:
30 FPS while keeping the density and visual fidelity
of all its environments + inhabitants.

tips.title: PSSR + RT SHADOWS
tips.body:
PS5 Pro gets sharper clarity via PSSR and
ray-traced shadows, only on PS5 Pro.

tips.title: HAPTICS + 3D AUDIO
tips.body:
High-fidelity haptics (adjustable in accessibility),
Tempest 3D Audio + improved load times.
